svg.metadata: DEXPI Diagram: P-01 - Generated with pyDEXPI 2.1.0 - https://github.com/process-intelligence-research/pyDEXPI

g.text: Feed 100 kmol/h methanol/water at 30 C. CS1: TIC-104 holds stage 35 by the total compressor power (JIC-105 sets K-101; K-102 and K-103 follow in fixed ratio).
CS1: FFIC-107 keeps reflux / distillate fixed. CS2: AIC-108 (distillate methanol, 3 min analyser lag) resets the ratio.
PIC-102 holds the column top pressure by the E-104 cooling (and so the FVC flow); PIC-103 holds the compressor discharge by PV-103.
Source names: C-101 COLUMN, K-101..103 COMP1..3, E-101..103 HEX1..3, E-104 COND, V-101 FLASH-D, V-102 FLASH-R,
FV-101 V1, PV-103 V2, FV-107 V3, LV-106 V4, LV-109 V6, LV-110 V8. Drawn by us for #335; DN indicative, not sized.
